operators.name: triu_forward

parameters.name: x
parameters.shape: same as reference step input [B, C, H, W]
parameters.layout: supports strides (input is contiguous per contract, but may be non-contiguous after previous ops?)

semantics: Performs torch.triu on the last two dimensions of a 4D tensor, independent of batch and channel dimensions.
Zeros elements below the main diagonal of each HxW matrix; elements on and above diagonal remain unchanged.
Input layout may be non-contiguous; output should be contiguous and match reference strides? The verification expects contiguous output of same shape. Ensure output is contiguous.

operators.name: conv2d_forward

returns.shape: [N, C_out, H_out, W_out] where H_out = floor((H_in + 2*padding - dilation*(kH-1) - 1)/stride + 1)

semantics: Performs 2D convolution as in torch.nn.functional.conv2d with given stride, padding, dilation, groups.
Weight shape [C_out, C_in, kH, kW]; bias shape [C_out] is added per output channel if bias is not None.
The call in model.py uses self.conv(x) which includes internal bias (since Conv2d bias=True). Therefore bias parameter must be passed as self.conv.bias.
Return tensor is contiguous with standard NCHW layout.

operators.name: add_bias_forward

parameters.name: bias
parameters.shape: [C, 1, 1] in this task, but generally broadcastable to x shape per PyTorch broadcasting

semantics: Performs element-wise addition of bias to x following PyTorch broadcasting rules.
bias shape [C,1,1] broadcasts over N and spatial dims.
Output is same shape as x, contiguous.
Zeros elements below main diagonal of last two dimensions.
2D convolution with weight [64,3,3,3], bias [64], stride=1, padding=0, dilation=1, groups=1.
Broadcasted addition of self.bias with shape [64,1,1].
